tools.name: aws_profiles
tools.description: The AWS profiles set up on this computer, and which one calls use when you name none.

tools.name: aws_identity
tools.description: The account, role and region a profile acts as. Fails with a clear message when its sign-in has expired.

profile.description: Leave out for the default, or the only profile.

region.description: Leave out for the profile's region.

tools.name: aws_ecs
tools.description: ECS clusters; a cluster's services; a service's deployments and recent events; or tasks with health, image and why they stopped.

profile.description: Leave out for the default, or the only profile.

region.description: Leave out for the profile's region.

cluster.description: Name or ARN; leave out to list clusters.

service.description: Name; with no tasks, its deployments and events.

tasks.description: List tasks, of the service or the whole cluster.

tools.name: aws_task_definition
tools.description: An ECS task definition's containers: image, cpu, memory, ports, log group, and the names of its environment variables and secrets.

profile.description: Leave out for the default, or the only profile.

region.description: Leave out for the profile's region.

tools.name: aws_target_health
tools.description: A load balancer's listeners, rules and target health, or one target group's. With neither, lists the load balancers.

profile.description: Leave out for the default, or the only profile.

region.description: Leave out for the profile's region.

tools.name: aws_logs
tools.description: The newest CloudWatch log events in a group, or one stream of it, optionally matching a filter pattern.

profile.description: Leave out for the default, or the only profile.

region.description: Leave out for the profile's region.

group.description: The log group. An unknown one lists groups with a similar name.

pattern.description: A CloudWatch filter pattern, like ERROR or "timed out".

limit.description: Events to return, newest kept. Default 100, at most 500.

tools.name: aws_metrics
tools.description: A CloudWatch metric over time, at most 120 points, oldest first.

profile.description: Leave out for the default, or the only profile.

region.description: Leave out for the profile's region.

dimensions.description: Name to value, like {"ClusterName":"prod","ServiceName":"api"}; all of the metric's.

stat.description: Average (default), Sum, Minimum, Maximum, SampleCount or a percentile like p99.

period.description: Seconds per point, widened to keep 120 points.

tools.name: aws_ec2
tools.description: EC2 instances with name, state, type and addresses.

profile.description: Leave out for the default, or the only profile.

region.description: Leave out for the profile's region.

name.description: Only instances whose name, id or IP contains this.
